narrative.offerRewardText: I am meditating on your task, adventurer.  Meditating on reasons why the Twilight's Hammer and naga are here.When you are ready, use the phial of scrying to create a scrying bowl.  Then, contact me through the bowl.If you have lost your phial of scrying, then here is another.
